_doc: Stable reason codes. Engine emits {code, params}; UI + LLM render 'text' (US English, imperial first). Add codes, never rename.

HEAD_PRIORITY.text: Strong on what you asked for: {priorities}.

HEAD_OVER92_CAP.text: Fast swing, but scores over 92 still need forgiveness.

HEAD_FORGIVENESS_PENALTY.text: Forged 301s are less forgiving, so they rank lower for you.

MATERIAL_GRAPHITE.text: Graphite: lighter and easier on the joints ({why}).

MATERIAL_STEEL.text: Steel: more control at your swing speed.

SHAFT_MODEL_MATCH.text: {model} fits your {flight} ball flight and {tempo} tempo.

LENGTH_LADY_FLEX.text: Ladies-flex builds add 1 in back to the chart length.

LIE_FROM_STATIC.text: Height + wrist-to-floor put your lie at {lie}.

GRIP_FROM_HAND.text: Hand length {hand_len} measured from photo: {grip} grip.

PURCHASE_CUSTOM.text: Custom because of {why}. Custom builds can't be returned.

NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE.text: Not sure yet. {next_step} will tighten this.

UNBUILDABLE.text: That combo can't be built; picked nearest option.

STOCK_LENGTH_TRADEOFF.text: Standard length would be {delta_in} in {direction} than your fit: posture and strike suffer a bit.

STOCK_LIE_TRADEOFF.text: Standard lie would start shots about {offline_yd} yd {direction}.

STOCK_GRIP_TRADEOFF.text: Midsize is the biggest stock grip; oversize needs custom.

CONTRADICTION.text: You said {asked} {asked_unit}, but we measured {measured} {unit}. Which is right?

HEAD_ALT_STRONGER.text: {alternative} rates higher on {priorities}; this head fits the rest of your game better.

CARRY_READ.text: You said {said} yd; we use about {used} yd, because most golfers remember their best shots.

SPEED_FROM_CARRY_LOFT.text: Speed estimated from your carry, adjusted for your {loft}° 7-iron.

SPEED_FROM_CARRY_TYPICAL_LOFT.text: Assumes a typical {loft}° 7-iron; lofts differ by brand, so tell us yours to sharpen this.

LENGTH_EFFECT.text: Too long and you stand up and catch the heel; too short and you hunch over and catch the toe.

LIE_EFFECT.text: Each 1° off starts a 7-iron about {offline_yd} yd off line: {upright_dir} if too upright, {flat_dir} if too flat.

SPEED_FROM_SCORE.text: Speed estimated from your typical score. A launch monitor or carry number would firm it up.

FLIGHT_FROM_LAUNCH.text: Your launch monitor numbers say you need a {flight} ball flight.

TEMPO_FROM_VIDEO.text: Your swing video timing reads as a {tempo} tempo.

TEMPO_VIDEO_UNCLEAR.text: The swing video timing was unclear, so your own tempo answer counts more ({tempo}).

LIE_FROM_BALL_LINE.text: Your ball-line test says {lie}. The mark exaggerates, so we scale it down.

STOCK_CLOSE_CALL.text: Standard is nearly as likely for {parts}, so a stock set (30-day returns) is worth considering.

NEXT_LAUNCH_MONITOR.text: Launch monitor numbers for your 7-iron would firm this up most.

NEXT_BALL_LINE.text: A ball-line test (five shots, one photo each) would show your lie at impact.

NEXT_SWING_VIDEO.text: A short swing video would measure your tempo on this device.

NEXT_GLOVE.text: Your glove size would firm up the grip size.

NEXT_HEIGHT.text: Your height would firm up the club length.

NEXT_CARRY.text: Your usual 7-iron carry would help estimate your swing speed.
